sources.title: Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer
sources.authority_reason: 稀疏 MoE 的提出者原始論文，直接定義獨立 expert、稀疏 gate、加權輸出與效能限制。
sources.inspection_note: Read the original versioned paper text. Independent experts and sparse weighted sums support the introduction. The paper uses noisy top-k with normalization over selected experts and describes k>1 task-gradient routing; it is not the identical implementation as this repository. Performance discussion explicitly identifies shrinking batches and bandwidth costs. No paper benchmark has been reproduced here, and no paper figure is claimed visually inspected. 實讀定位與原始 PDF/text SHA 保存在 a2；主要核 sections 1.2, 2, 2.1, 3.1-3.2。

sources.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
sources.authority_reason: Switch 作者的原始 JMLR 論文，直接說明 top-1 softmax gate、可微路徑與負載輔助項。
sources.inspection_note: Read versioned original. Equation (2) retains the selected softmax gate for top-1, explaining a task-gradient path; equations (4)-(6) support the load/probability auxiliary term. The repository top-2 convention is separately normalized and its dropless loop differs from Switch capacity-limited routing. Only the introduction concepts and code-navigation promise are certified; paper quality/speed numbers are not imported into the verdict. No paper figure is claimed visually inspected. 實讀 section 2.1 equations (1)-(2)、2.2 equations (4)-(6)、2.3 footnote 5；原檔 SHA 與定位在 a2。
